Config.description: Which repositories to scan, and which of them the others are compared against.

include_archived.description: Also scan the archived repositories of an organization. They are skipped by default.

include_forks.description: Also scan the forks an organization owns. They are skipped by default.

main.description: The repository (`owner/name`) every other one is compared against: con/sistent's source of truth. It is scanned whether or not it is listed anywhere else. Defaults to the first entry of `repositories`.

organizations.description: GitHub organizations (or users) whose public repositories are all scanned. Forks and archived repositories are left out unless `include_forks` or `include_archived` is set.

repositories.description: Individual repositories to scan, each written as `owner/name` so that it is never ambiguous which one is meant. A repository listed here is scanned even when it is a fork or archived. Unless `main` says otherwise, the first entry is the one every other repository is compared against, so there has to be at least one.
